cover.title: 5 mistakes that ruin a homemade cake
cover.sub: Save this before your next bake

items.title: Cold eggs and butter
items.text: Take them out an hour before. Cold fat won't trap air, so the cake comes out dense.

items.title: Opening the oven early
items.text: The first 20 minutes set the structure. A blast of cold air and the middle sinks.

items.title: Measuring flour with a cup
items.text: A scooped cup can hold 30% more flour. Weigh it, or spoon it in and level it.

items.title: Over-mixing after the flour
items.text: Mix only until you can't see dry flour. More mixing builds gluten and makes it chewy.

items.title: Cutting it hot
items.text: Let it cool on a rack for an hour. Warm cake crumbles and the cream melts.
